stem.text: Equal volumes of saturated solutions of magnesium hydroxide, calcium hydroxide and strontium hydroxide are completely neutralised with dilute sulfuric acid.
The water is gently evaporated from each of the resulting solutions, leaving the corresponding solid sulfates.
These solid sulfates are completely dissolved in the minimum volume of water needed to produce saturated solutions.
Which statement about the volumes of water needed to dissolve the sulfates is correct?

A.text: The calcium sulfate will require the greatest volume of water.

B.text: The magnesium sulfate will require the greatest volume of water.

C.text: The strontium sulfate will require the greatest volume of water.

D.text: They will all require the same volume of water.
